summary: This note is a short biographical entry for Rob Larter, a geologist. It covers his academic path: a Geology degree from Durham University in 1982, a PhD in Geological Sciences from the University of Birmingham in 1991, and a stint as a Research Associate with the Antarctic Marine Group at Birmingham University from 1983 to 1987.
one_line: Rob Larter is a geologist whose education at Durham and Birmingham universities led to Antarctic marine geology research.
key_facts: Rob Larter graduated from Durham University in 1982.
Rob Larter's degree from Durham University was in Geology.
Rob Larter completed a PhD in Geological Sciences at the University of Birmingham in 1991.
Rob Larter was a Research Associate with the Antarctic Marine Group at Birmingham University.
Rob Larter's Research Associate position with the Antarctic Marine Group lasted from 1983 to 1987.
